residual_failures.description: One record per tolerated (non-fatal) extract failure, written alongside raw/processed/transformed so tolerated failures are reviewable after the run instead of only appearing in pod logs.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: UTC instant the failure was recorded, as ISO-8601 from datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().

fields.name: category
fields.description: Machine-readable failure category, e.g. dashboard_detail_fetch_failed — the key a reviewer groups and counts by.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Metabase API path whose call failed, e.g. /api/dashboard. Passed by every call site.

fields.name: http_status
fields.description: HTTP status when the response carried one; null when there was no usable response, and absent entirely for question_query_fetch_errored, which records no status.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Metabase integer ID of the one record that failed; absent for list-level failures (collections/dashboards/questions/databases fetch) where no single record is to blame.
